plan.title: Activation checkpointing on residual blocks
plan.description: Wrap each ResidualBlock forward with torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint to recompute activations during backward instead of retaining the full depth's activation tensors. Preserves original forward/backward mathematics, loss, optimizer step cadence (SGD, 20 updates), and FP32 precision. Source: train.py lines 21-30 (ResidualBlock.forward) and 99 (model(inputs)).

plan.title: Switch AdamW to foreach=False
plan.description: Disable foreach=True in torch.optim.AdamW (line 119) to avoid per-parameter temporary buffers during the fused update; preserves optimizer class, hyperparameters, parameter groups, state layout, and update cadence.

plan.title: Activation checkpointing in ResidualBlock
plan.description: Wrap each ResidualBlock forward with torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint to discard per-block activations after backward. The model forward at train.py:28-30 applies blocks sequentially and returns hidden.mean(dim=1); checkpointing preserves the identical computation graph and loss objective. The training path uses train_inputs [1,512,768] with effective_batch_per_optimizer_update=1 and backwards_per_optimizer_update=1 (runtime_input_observations.logical_updates).

evidence_requests.detail: Need confirmed loss denominator (mean over N elements) and per-chunk weighting to guarantee gradient equivalence under checkpoint recomputation.

plan.title: Remove retain_graph=True from backward()
plan.description: Change loss.backward(retain_graph=True) to loss.backward() in train.py line 104. The source shows each iteration does a fresh forward pass (line 100), so the autograd graph is not reused across iterations. Removing this flag allows immediate graph and activation buffer release after each backward, eliminating the cumulative activations peak.

plan.title: Remove retain_graph=True from backward()
plan.description: Change loss.backward(retain_graph=True) to loss.backward() at train.py:104. Each backward traverses the graph once; retaining the graph is unnecessary and causes forward activations to accumulate across steps.

plan.title: Checkpoint GELU + addmm residual add
plan.description: Wrap each layer's GELU + addmm + residual add with torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint to recompute activations during backward, avoiding retention of per-layer forward outputs. Preserves all samples, order, loss (MSE mean over batch*seq*width), optimizer step cadence (20 updates), and SGD semantics. Requires allow_batch_grad_accum=false (no accumulation change).

evidence_requests.detail: Loss reduction semantics (MSE mean over batch*seq*width) and per-update effective batch are not confirmed; required to validate gradient accumulation or microbatch strategies without changing the objective.

plan.title: Stream cross-entropy over vocabulary chunks (fp32, mean reduction)
plan.description: Replace full-vocabulary logits materialization and its fp32 copy with token-streamed NLL: for each vocab chunk compute log_softmax in fp32, gather target log-probs, accumulate mean NLL over all tokens, backward once per step. Preserves original mean reduction denominator (batch*length), masks, ignore_index, label_smoothing, and fp32 logits for CE. No precision change.

plan.title: Stream cross-entropy over vocabulary chunks (fp32, mean reduction)
plan.description: Replace full [batch*length, vocabulary] logits.float() + cross_entropy with token-wise log_softmax on vocabulary chunks of size 256. Accumulate loss_sum over chunks, divide by total valid tokens (N) to preserve mean reduction. Keep fp32 for numerics. Backward once after full loss. No change to optimizer step cadence, model, or precision.

plan.title: Freeze backbone params and pass only head params to optimizer
plan.description: Disable requires_grad on backbone.parameters() before constructing AdamW, and pass model.head.parameters() (or filter requires_grad=True) to optimizer. This removes backbone params from optimizer_state (moments) and from grads, preserving the intended head-only fine-tune objective and original update cadence (20 steps).

plan.title: Exclude backbone from optimizer and disable its gradients
plan.description: Set requires_grad=False on model.backbone parameters before constructing optimizer; pass only model.head.parameters() to AdamW. This removes optimizer state (moments) for ~1.076B backbone elements and avoids gradient buffers for them, while preserving the exact same forward computation and loss (cross_entropy on head output). The head remains trainable with identical lr, foreach=False, weight decay, and scheduler semantics. Optimizer step count, update cadence, and effective batch are unchanged.

evidence_requests.detail: Prior verification reported loss_comparable=false and loss_tolerance=false for candidate f1; the exact objective and effective batch equivalence under the freeze-head-only change is unresolved. Need host decision or additional reference evidence on whether the same mathematical objective is preserved.
The verifier unknown_checks included same_objective=null; without confirmation that the training objective (loss reduction axes, masks, weights) is identical, numerical equivalence cannot be assumed.

plan.title: Remove unused teacher model creation
plan.description: The train.py script creates a teacher model (lines 96-99) that is never used because distillation_weight=0.0 (line 100). The teacher model parameters (2.99 GB) remain resident on GPU for the entire run. Delete the teacher model instantiation and its parameter counting from the workload emission to eliminate this allocation entirely.

plan.title: Lazy-create teacher model only when distillation_weight > 0
plan.description: Move teacher instantiation inside the distillation_weight > 0 guard so the teacher model (2.98 GB params) is never created when distillation_weight=0.0 as in the supplied scenario. This avoids the resident teacher parameters entirely.
